question: Which of the following Union Ministries appointed Prof. (Dr.) Soumya Swaminathan as Principal Advisor for the National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme in July 2024?

options.text: Union Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Union Ministry of Health and Family Welfare**__.

• Prof. (**Dr. Soumya Swaminathan**), a renowned scientist in the field of **public health**, was appointed as Principal Advisor for the **National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme** by the **Union Ministry of Health and Family Welfare** in July 2024.
